_verified: 2026-10-28 against the docs above (no live call): POST https://api.cartesia.ai/tts/bytes, `Authorization: Bearer <key>`, required `Cartesia-Version` (the OpenAPI enum lists only 2026-08-14), required model_id/transcript/voice/output_format, MP3 output_format = { container: mp3, sample_rate, bit_rate } (defaults 44100 / 128000), model enum sonic-3.6 (default) | sonic-3.5 | sonic-3 | sonic-latest, optional `language` (base code or locale; never together with `locale`)
